modeRationale: No platform has native achievements for this app: Nintendo Switch has no platform-level achievement system at all; no evidence found of Game Center (iOS) or Google Play Games (Android) achievement integration for Pokémon HOME on mobile (absence-of-evidence, medium confidence, no explicit official denial found). HOME's own internal checklists (Switch 'Research Tasks', mobile 'Challenges'/'Medals') are in-app completionist systems, not OS-level achievement APIs, so they don't trigger the entry gate — they're source material, not a competing native list.

criticalPlatformSplit.summary: This is the single most important fact for design. A large share of Pokémon HOME's feature set is MOBILE-APP-ONLY and does not exist on the Nintendo Switch build at all — confirmed directly via Nintendo's own support FAQ ('The ability to trade Pokémon is only available in the smart device version of Pokémon HOME').
switchOnly: Deposit/withdraw to/from compatible Switch games (Let's Go, Sword/Shield, BDSP, Legends Arceus, Scarlet/Violet, Legends Z-A, FireRed/LeafGreen)
Research Tasks checklist (140 tasks, 7 sets of 20, no in-app reward)
National + regional Pokédex tracking (shared with mobile)
mobileOnly: All trading: GTS, Wonder Box, Room Trade, Friend Trade
Friend list / 'Your Room' social features (not linked to Switch system friends)
Challenges (mobile's reward-bearing checklist — gives stickers/backgrounds, unlike Switch's reward-less Research Tasks)
Mystery Gift reception for several gifts (even some earned via a Switch action — see Celebi gotcha below)
Pokémon GO's GO Transporter connection (GO talks to the mobile HOME app, not the Switch app, though the cloud storage is shared)
criticalPlatformSplit.implication: No base-list trophy can require trading, friends, Challenges, Medals, or Battle Data if the list targets the Switch/Switch 2 app. Any trophy touching one of these must either be dropped or explicitly disclosed as requiring the companion mobile app, the way this project discloses other external dependencies (Rule 13).

coreSwitchSystems.storage: Basic/free Plan: 1 box ('Basic Box'), 30 Pokémon cap. Premium Plan: 9,000 Pokémon across ~300 boxes as of the October 7, 2026 update (v4.1.0) — raised from 6,000/200 boxes at no price change. First login grants a free Pikachu.
coreSwitchSystems.pokedex: HOME keeps its own National Pokédex (species registered the moment one is deposited — binary registered/not, no seen/owned split) plus per-regional-dexes (Kanto/Let's Go, Kanto/FireRed-LeafGreen, Galar+DLC, Sinnoh, Hisui, Paldea+DLC, Kalos/Legends Z-A), each only counting Pokémon natively obtained in that specific game. Current National Dex stands at 1,025 species (medium confidence denominator, since it shifts whenever a new game connects). Progress shown via bar + crown icon at 100%; exact numeric percentage display not confirmed.

pokedexRewards.national100percent: Original Color (gold/red) Magearna — unique to this gift, availability window as of Oct 2026 not freshly confirmed (medium confidence it's still live).

regional.dex: Galar + Isle of Armor + Crown Tundra (Sword/Shield)
Lumiose + Hyperspace Lumiose + Mega (Legends Z-A + Mega Dimension DLC)
regional.reward: Shiny Volcanion (first-ever Shiny release of this species)

pokedexRewards.confidence: medium per reward — corroborated by Pokémon.com/Bulbagarden press coverage, but exact current live/expired status of each as of Oct 2026 has some source conflict (see conflicts).

coreSwitchSystems.researchTasks: Switch-exclusive checklist, the Switch counterpart to mobile's Challenges. 7 sets × 20 tasks = 140 total as of the Oct 2026 update: Kanto/Let's Go, Kanto/FireRed-LeafGreen (new), Galar/Sword-Shield, Sinnoh/BDSP, Hisui/Legends Arceus, Paldea/Scarlet-Violet, Kalos/Legends Z-A. Each task requires depositing a specific species natively obtained in that game (wrong-origin same-species does not count). No in-app reward. Not confirmed whether an aggregate 'X/140' counter displays anywhere, or only per-task/per-set state — treat as a real risk for Rule 1 verification wording.
coreSwitchSystems.judge: IV-checking tool, Premium Plan only, accessed by pressing Y twice on a Pokémon.
coreSwitchSystems.homePoints: Passive currency (~1 point/31 Pokémon stored/night), convertible 30:1 to Battle Points in linked Switch games. Viewable via a 'P' icon.

connectedGames.direction: bidirectional (but a Pokémon sent onward to a newer game can never return)
forward-lock only — a Pokémon moved INTO Z-A can never return to any earlier title, and Z-A-native Pokémon can't move to earlier titles at all
ONE-WAY, DEPOSIT ONLY — confirmed no withdrawal path back into these games exists

connectedGames.game: Pokémon Bank (Nintendo 3DS, not a Switch title)
connectedGames.note: Bridges pre-Switch generations. Pokémon Bank itself is scheduled to end service Feb 25-26, 2027 — a real, near-term deadline for any trophy built on this bridge.

connectedGames.direction: one-way (GO→HOME only), MOBILE APP SIDE ONLY — not the Switch app
connectedGames.note: Heavily restricted: 25/batch, energy-cost cap, many exclusions (Shadow, Mega, Gmax, Buddy, Gym-defenders, costumed, Hyper-Trained, Safari-Ball-caught pre-Oct-2026). Not something a Switch-only trophy can be built around.

connectedGames.connected: April 8, 2026, via in-app link (both console and mobile)
connectedGames.direction: round-trip 'visitor' system, not a normal deposit/withdraw
connectedGames.note: CLASSIFICATION FLAG: this is a battle/tournament spin-off (competitive simulator) with no exploration or regional Pokédex of its own — structurally unlike the mainline RPGs. Both scouts independently flagged this as not fitting the 'core-series DLC pack' mold cleanly. Needs a human decision on whether it gets its own DLC pack or is left out.

ongoing.condition: deposit a Pokémon originally from Sword/Shield
complete the Kanto Pokédex in the Switch FireRed/LeafGreen re-release
ongoing.status: announced Oct 7 2026, live from Oct 26 2026, no stated expiration
ongoing.CRITICAL_GOTCHA: The qualifying action (Pokédex completion) happens on Switch, but the gift itself is delivered ONLY through the mobile HOME app — a Switch-only player (no mobile install) cannot actually claim it despite having earned it.

expiredDoNotUse: Shiny Meloetta original window (ended Oct 16 2024 — note the Shiny Meloetta regional-dex-completion reward may be a SEPARATE, still-ongoing mechanic per Scout B; this specific dated window is the one confirmed expired)
homeExclusiveDistributions.conflictNote: Scout C found sources describing several 2025-2026 regional-dex-completion shiny gifts as having specific expiry dates already passed, while Scout A/B found other sources describing the same gifts as live/retroactive with no end date. UNRESOLVED — design should avoid committing to a specific gift being 'currently claimable' without hedging, or should frame regional-dex-completion trophies around the Pokédex completion itself (clearly real and ongoing) rather than the gift's live status (uncertain).

subscriptionGate.basic: 30 Pokémon storage, Wonder Box x3 (mobile), GTS x1 (mobile), Room Trade participate-only (mobile), no Pokémon Bank transfer, no Judge function, 30 medals (mobile)
subscriptionGate.premium: 9,000 Pokémon storage (300 boxes), Wonder Box x10 (mobile), GTS x3 (mobile), Room Trade host+participate (mobile), Pokémon Bank transfer enabled, Judge function enabled, 1,000 medals (mobile)

conflicts.claimA: Only per-task/per-set silhouette-reveal state is shown.
conflicts.resolution: Unresolved. Any Research-Task trophy should verify against per-set completion (which is confirmed to exist) rather than assert an unconfirmed aggregate counter.

conflicts.topic: Regional-dex-completion shiny gifts (Manaphy/Enamorus/Keldeo/Volcanion/Z-A starter trio) — currently live or already expired?
conflicts.claimA: No end date, retroactive, still claimable (Scout A/B).
conflicts.claimB: Specific expiry dates already passed as of Oct 2026 (Scout C).
conflicts.resolution: Unresolved. Design should anchor trophies on the Pokédex completion itself (confirmed, stable) and treat the gift as a bonus the description can mention without guaranteeing current claimability.

conflicts.topic: National Pokédex 100%-completion Magearna gift — currently live?
conflicts.claimA: Ongoing since 2020, no confirmed end date.
conflicts.claimB: Historically had a ~1-month claim window after completion; current Oct 2026 status not freshly confirmed.
conflicts.resolution: Unresolved. Same treatment as above — anchor on the completion fact, not the gift's live status.

gaps: No confirmed aggregate Research Task completion percentage/counter UI.
No confirmed exact current National Dex denominator as displayed inside HOME specifically (vs. the general 'official' 1,025 species figure).
No confirmed box wallpaper/theme customization feature within HOME itself.
Conflicting info on several 2025-2026 Mystery Gift live/expired statuses (see conflicts).
Pokémon Champions' classification as a DLC-pack candidate is a human judgment call, not a fact gap — flagged for the checkpoint.
Pokémon HOME achievement-integration absence is medium confidence (absence-of-evidence, not an explicit official denial).
No Switch 2-specific HOME feature differences found; treated as functionally identical to Switch 1.
